cell_type_context: Human cutaneous T-cell lymphoma cells and lymphoid/receptor-reconstitution systems exposed to IL-7 or IL-15
compartment_context: Extracellular IL-7 engagement of IL7RA:IL2RG; receptor-associated JAK1/JAK3; nuclear STAT5 and BCL2 promoter/enhancer elements
injury_context: No SCI transfer inferred; lymphoid comparator model context only
context_scope: The IL-7 receptor/JAK/STAT5 route is joined to primary IL-7-associated BCL2 expression and STAT5 promoter-enhancer DNA-binding evidence while retaining the study's shared IL-7/IL-15 context
assay_or_perturbation: IL-7 or IL-15 stimulation; BCL2 expression measurements; STAT5 DNA-binding assays at BCL2 promoter-enhancer elements; receptor/JAK/STAT5 activation assays
citation_note: Primary studies support IL-7-associated STAT5 activation and BCL2 expression with STAT5 DNA-binding at BCL2 promoter-enhancer elements
evidence_summary: Composite primary-supported claim: IL-7 engages the IL7RA:IL2RG receptor and JAK/STAT5 signaling, while IL-7-associated BCL2 induction is accompanied by STAT5 DNA-binding at BCL2 promoter-enhancer elements. This supplies a bounded IL-7-to-BCL2 evidence route.
limitations: The BCL2 study uses IL-7 and IL-15 comparator stimulation in a cutaneous T-cell lymphoma model and reports STAT5 DNA-binding alongside other STAT factors; it does not isolate every receptor-proximal intermediate or establish a universal IL-7-only direct STAT5-to-BCL2 mechanism. No SCI transfer, causal graph traversal or database confidence score is asserted.
